task_name: World 107 Task A  -  Three-Entity Intercompany Loan Matrix vs. Commercial Bean Sale & Unmatched Checks

rubric.description: Identifies the supported $876.00 intercompany transfer from Broadway (#8375) to Fort Lee (#5853) on 2026-08-24.
Preserves the $3,000.00 Broadway->Corp ACH 0656 ('autopay for monthly beans') as commercial COGS 88 / Wholesale Sales 134 rather than reclassifying to intercompany loan.
Flags CHK-2439 ($4,158.04 plus two $100.00 receipts in Broadway vs two $100.00 checks in Corp) as unmatched due to reference mismatch.
Flags CHK-2395 ($4,000.00 on 9/10 in Broadway vs unrelated $4,000.00 remote deposit on 9/09 in Corp) as unmatched.
Flags Broadway AMEX A8988 ($4,093.25 on 9/28) as having no counterpart in Corp or Fort Lee bank feeds.
Distinguishes true intercompany treasury transfers from recurring commercial inventory purchases ('autopay for monthly beans') between related parties.
Requires exact counterparty/date/reference corroboration across both entity bank feeds before booking Due To / Due From reclassifications.

prompt: Perform a comprehensive Multi-Entity Treasury & Related-Party Matrix review using the world files (`three_entity_transfer_matrix_aug_oct_2026.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.
gold_output:
World 107 Task A  -  Three-Entity Intercompany Loan Matrix vs. Commercial Bean Sale & Unmatched Traps:
1. Supported Fort Lee (#9019/#5853) <-> Corp (#8888/#0649) Intercompany Loans: 4 matched pairs ($3,000.00 on 8/24, $4,000.00 on 9/02, $4,000.00 on 9/08, and $1,000.00 on 9/22) yield $8,000.00 Corp->FL minus $4,000.00 FL->Corp = net $4,000.00 Corp->FL funding.
2. Supported Broadway (#8375) -> Fort Lee (#5853) Transfer: $876.00 on 2026-08-24 is verified across both bank feeds.
3. Commercial Related-Party Inventory Sale Preserved: The $3,000.00 Broadway->Corp ACH 0656 ('autopay for monthly beans') on 9/29-30 is a recurring commercial inventory purchase and must remain in COGS 88 / Wholesale Sales 134 rather than an intercompany loan.
4. Unmatched Items Held pending Corroboration: CHK-2439 ($4,158.04 plus two $100.00 receipts in Broadway vs two $100.00 checks in Corp with mismatched refs), CHK-2395 ($4,000.00 on 9/10 in Broadway vs unrelated $4,000.00 remote deposit on 9/09 in Corp), and Broadway AMEX A8988 ($4,093.25 on 9/28 with no Corp/FL bank counterpart) are blocked from Due To / Due From reclassification.
